# sngl extract: collect translatable strings and output JSON template.

sngl extract app.sngl
stdout '"msgid": "Login"'
stdout '"msgid": "Hello \{0\}!"'
stdout '"file": "app.sngl"'

# --out-format pot writes GNU gettext template.
sngl extract --out-format pot app.sngl
stdout 'msgid "Login"'
stdout 'msgid "Hello \{0\}!"'
stdout 'msgstr ""'

# Non-translatable strings are excluded.
sngl extract app.sngl
! stdout '"msgid": "regular string"'

# --out-format arb writes Flutter ARB JSON.
sngl extract --out-format arb app.sngl
stdout '"@@locale": "en"'
stdout '"msg0": "Login"'

-- app.sngl --
component main {
  var greeting = $"Login"
  var welcome = $"Hello {greeting}!"
  var ignored = "regular string"
}
